Scenarios come baseline’s vignettes (from_vignettes()), help-page examples (from_examples()) scenario files written scenario() step(). prepare_versions() builds versions source installs library, recording provenance; dependencies come current library (deps_shared()), current CRAN versions (deps_cran()), CRAN baseline’s release date (deps_snapshot()). run_scenarios() runs scenarios version R process, twice per version ABBA order, run per-step time limits (300 s one execution step default); step runs past limit crashes R recorded error run goes without . Runs cached reused nothing shapes changes. run_dossier() runs every stage; package’s folder, run_dossier() arguments makes dossier folder CRAN release, opens report prints verdict, says write instead start. compare_runs() labels difference one twenty kinds: new fixed errors warnings, changed condition classes, moved numbers, removed added elements, changed output plots (share changed pixels), slower faster steps, unstable steps, changes exported functions’ signatures. attaches candidate’s NEWS bullets name function step uses, records exported functions NEWS bullets scenarios exercise. print(), summary() differences() give results text data; write_dossier_html() writes standalone HTML report, write_dossier_json() JSON published schema, write_dossier_md() summary pull-request comment.
